implementation.targetScope: Synchronous event emitter library API, typed event maps, browser and Node consumers. No runtime dependencies.

source: Written from public contracts and behavioral tests with ordered listener arrays; no upstream runtime source copied. Modern built-ins replace historical compatibility branches.
changes: An explicit empty-string event passed to removeAllListeners removes only that event, instead of clearing unrelated subscriptions.
Dispatch preserves the original listener array and length while mutations update subsequent dispatches; once listeners retire before recursion or exceptions.
